name: edit_file
description: Find-and-replace edit for existing files. This is the PREFERRED tool for modifying code. CRITICAL: old_text must match the file content EXACTLY, including all whitespace and indentation. Include at least 3-5 lines of context before and after the change point to ensure uniqueness. This tool replaces ONE occurrence — make separate calls for multiple changes. Always use read_file first to verify the exact content before editing.

path.description: File path relative to project root

old_text.description: Exact text to find (must match file content precisely, including whitespace and indentation. Include enough surrounding context to be unique)

new_text.description: Replacement text. Ensure the result is idiomatic, correct code. Do not leave the code in a broken state
